# Serialized measured-data admission

The public C++ text, file, batch and project-mode loaders run in a small consumer
linked to the prepared complete engine. Python factories, collections and project
loading are exercised directly. Native inputs declare different embedded,
linked-file and collection measurements. Every pair and the three-way conflict
must refuse before admission; supported single-source controls retain their
authored values and declarations. A legitimately hydrated linked project must
still save and reopen.

CIF has a different declared rule: it carries its own data and location items are
reported unread. The exported CIF converter and every CIF-capable loader must
preserve the embedded data, report the supplied location names, and avoid reading
the unrelated external file. The corpus uses the declared native and CIF item
spellings. Reflection link support is an open product scope decision; reflection
embedded-data controls and all conflicting native declarations remain exercised.

The existing public-model preparation target builds this consumer before pytest.
Pytest never compiles it. For a separately prepared local consumer, the build
receipt binds the complete consumer, builder, core archives, public
headers and selected SDK to the executable. A supplied receipt is revalidated
before execution. It does not turn a local SDK diagnostic into published-SDK or
shipping CI evidence.
